scope: Isolated CPU benchmark on USB reMarkable 2; no UI restart or artwork change
workload: 400 alternating shading segments, 1200x1600 pixels, pressure 0.65; allocation/init excluded
limitation: One measurement per case, old then UAT order. Not a statistically controlled timing study, GUI/frame latency or human input test.
prototype: Position-only clump byte cache + response lookup; exact-state regression passed but no CPU speedup observed, NOT shipped
conclusion: Material CPU change alone does not explain the reported severe slowdown. User-reported UAT responsiveness regression remains OPEN; requires safe full GUI-path profiling before promotion.
